text.hi: दो वाक्य who (कौन), which (कौन सा), when (जब), where (जहाँ) से जुड़ते हैं। किताब का उदाहरण: Ranjana wants to buy a book. Ramu has the same book. → Ranjana wants to buy the same book which Ramu has.
text.hinglish: Do vaakya who (kaun), which (kaun sa), when (jab), where (jahan) se judte hain. Kitaab ka udaharan: Ranjana wants to buy a book. Ramu has the same book. → Ranjana wants to buy the same book which Ramu has.
text.en: Two sentences can be joined with who, which, when or where. The book's example: Ranjana wants to buy a book. Ramu has the same book. → Ranjana wants to buy the same book which Ramu has.

prompt.hi: जोड़ो (when): Mother went to market. Ramu was sleeping.
prompt.hinglish: Jodo (when): Mother went to market. Ramu was sleeping.
prompt.en: Join with ‘when’: Mother went to market. Ramu was sleeping.

steps.answer: Mother went to market when Ramu was sleeping.

text.hi: ‘too ... to’ = इतना ज़्यादा कि नहीं हो सकता। इसे ‘so ... that ... cannot’ से लिख सकते हैं। Tea is too hot to drink. → Tea is so hot that it cannot be drunk। (drink, drank, drunk)
text.hinglish: ‘too ... to’ = itna zyaada ki nahi ho sakta. Ise ‘so ... that ... cannot’ se likh sakte hain. Tea is too hot to drink. → Tea is so hot that it cannot be drunk. (drink, drank, drunk)
text.en: ‘too ... to’ means so much that it can't be done. We can rewrite it with ‘so ... that ... cannot’. Tea is too hot to drink. → Tea is so hot that it cannot be drunk. (drink, drank, drunk)
